hooks.name: Agent Model Guard
hooks.description: Blocks an agent profile that declares no model. The default is `auto` at 1.0x chosen per request, which is the wrong tier at both ends: a cargo-runner with clippy as its arbiter belongs on 0.05x, an unsafe reviewer nothing re-checks belongs on 2.2x. All five profiles were unset until 2026-09-06 because nothing visibly breaks when the field is missing. Does not validate the ID — an unknown one falls back to the default, the same outcome as omitting it. Fails open. Logic: bin/agent-model-guard.sh.
